cohort: 57 pregnant women diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection, including both symptomatic (n=20) and asymptomatic (n=37) individuals.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy influences angiogenic balance, with asymptomatic COVID-19 patients exhibiting higher sFlt-1 serum levels and differing sFlt-1/PlGF ratios compared to symptomatic patients, suggesting a potential for placental dysfunction if the infection is left untreated.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at SARS-CoV-2 diagnosis was 32 weeks for symptomatic patients and 37 weeks 5 days for asymptomatic patients, with ratio stratification used for cases before or after 34 weeks of gestation.
